items.line: `find_author` ... runs the name search with the flipped name, then the alternate-names search, then the surname search. It owns the order
items.requirement: find_entity must attempt resolution in priority order: name with dates, alternate_names with dates, surname with dates

items.line: When both dates are given, an exact year match on both outranks other matches.
items.requirement: When both birth_date and death_date are present, they disambiguate records and an exact year match for both takes precedence

items.line: When either date is missing, the name alone decides.
items.requirement: When either date is absent, fall back to case-insensitive name matching alone, returning an existing author if one exists

items.line: An import names an author. The search ignores case, and a `*` in the name matches any characters.
items.requirement: Matching must be case-insensitive; different casings resolve to the same author record

items.line: **When** an import names "John\*" with no dates, **Then** OL2A is returned, the lowest numeric key. ... **Then** nothing is found and the import keeps the candidate name "Zed\*".
items.requirement: Wildcards in name patterns: "John*" returns first candidate by numeric key ordering; if no match, new candidate preserving name including *

items.line: Both input dates are required, and the candidate must have both dates with equal years.
items.requirement: Alternate_names match requires both dates present in input and exactly matching the candidate's values

items.line: Both input dates are required, and the candidate must have both dates with equal years.
items.requirement: Surname match requires both dates present and exactly matching; must not resolve if either date is missing or mismatched

items.line: `find_author` takes the import dictionary and returns the candidates of the first search that finds any. ... `find_entity` delegates to it and picks one candidate, or `None`.
items.requirement: find_author accepts the import dict and returns a list of candidates; find_entity delegates to find_author and returns an existing record or None
